|game_text='''0 side — Twin Suns Of Tatooine'''

Deploy Tatooine system and a non-Jabba's Palace Tatooine site. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Jabba's Palace sites or Sandwhirl. While this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Tatooine battleground site. Flip this card if you control two Tatooine battleground sites (at least one with a Dark Jedi) and occupy Tatooine system, and opponent controls no Tatooine sites.

'''7 side — Well Trained In The Jedi Arts'''

While this side up, once per game, may ▼ Tatooine Occupation. Once during your control phase, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle Reserve Deck. For opponent to move a character or vehicle from same site as your Dark Jedi requires +1 Force. Flip this card if opponent controls more Tatooine sites than you.

A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
